Title: System architecture & tech stack
Description: Create system architecture diagram, select tech stack, and infra plan
AcceptanceCriteria: Diagram and infra choices reviewed by tech lead

Title: Data model design
Description: Design ERD for Clinic/Provider/Service/Slot/Appointment
AcceptanceCriteria: ERD + sample migrations available

Title: Booking API (availability & create)
Description: Implement `GET /availability` and `POST /appointments` with idempotency and transactional reservation
AcceptanceCriteria: End-to-end flow creates appointment and marks slot reserved; unit tests

Title: Repo & CI setup
Description: Setup repository structure, CI basics, linting
AcceptanceCriteria: PR created and CI lint passes

Title: Provider availability CRUD
Description: Implement ProviderAvailability CRUD and recurring exceptions
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can create recurring hours and exceptions

Title: Slot generation engine
Description: Generate slots from availability with buffer and lead-time rules
AcceptanceCriteria: Generated slots reflect rules; unit tests for edge cases

Title: Provider dashboard (baseline)
Description: Daily view, block/unblock slots UI
AcceptanceCriteria: UI displays schedule and allows manual overrides

Title: Calendar sync spec
Description: Design Google/Outlook OAuth and webhook integration stub
AcceptanceCriteria: OAuth + token storage spec; stubbed webhook endpoint

Title: Patient booking UI
Description: Responsive booking UI: search → service → slot → book
AcceptanceCriteria: Usability-tested flow; e2e test

Title: Notification service skeleton
Description: Queue, worker, and template system for notifications
AcceptanceCriteria: Worker can enqueue and send emails in dev mode

Title: Confirmation email + SMS
Description: Integrate email + Twilio SMS for booking confirmations
AcceptanceCriteria: Booking triggers email + SMS (or simulated SMS)

Title: Notification idempotency & retries
Description: Idempotency and retry/backoff for notification delivery
AcceptanceCriteria: Retry policy implemented; metrics emitted

Title: Reschedule & cancel flows
Description: APIs and UI for rescheduling and cancellations with policy enforcement
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can reschedule within policy; logs created

Title: Waiting list & auto-fill
Description: Implement waiting list and auto-fill when cancellations occur
AcceptanceCriteria: Auto-notify next patient and reserve slot; race-condition tests

Title: Check-in flow
Description: QR/code-based quick check-in to update appointment status
AcceptanceCriteria: Check-in updates appointment status and reduces front-desk steps

Title: Audit logging for lifecycle events
Description: Record create/reschedule/cancel/check-in actions
AcceptanceCriteria: Audit entries recorded for lifecycle events

Title: Auth & RBAC
Description: Implement OAuth2/JWT and role-based access control
AcceptanceCriteria: Role-protected endpoints; auth tests

Title: PHI encryption & retention
Description: Encrypt PHI at rest, secure backups, and retention policy
AcceptanceCriteria: DB encryption configured and retention documented

Title: End-to-end & integration tests
Description: E2E tests covering booking and notifications
AcceptanceCriteria: CI runs e2e suite and passes threshold

Title: Load testing & tuning
Description: Load test scheduling service; tune DB indexes/locks
AcceptanceCriteria: Documented capacity; no double-booking under load

Title: Staging pilot deployment
Description: Deploy staging pilot, migrate sample clinic data, run pilot scripts
AcceptanceCriteria: Pilot clinic can book real appointments; feedback logged

Title: Monitoring & tracing
Description: Prometheus/Grafana dashboards and tracing setup
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboards for booking rate, error rate, notification failures

Title: Training materials & runbook
Description: Create admin docs, training materials, and runbook
AcceptanceCriteria: Docs available and 1-hour training runbook prepared

Title: Security review & pre-launch checklist
Description: Conduct security review and prepare pre-launch checklist
AcceptanceCriteria: Vulnerabilities logged and mitigation plan
